page.overview:
Who is Inori's Brother?

He was a shinobi from an unknown village and the older brother of Inori.

He cared very much for his sister, being able to locate her when she disappeared to Boro's Cult. He did not believe Boro's tales of the Infinite Tsukuyomi's grace, attempting to convince his sister of its fallacies. He showed some degree of despair when he could not kill Boro, but immediately expressed courage, choosing to die rather than join the cult.

He was a young man of medium height with short purple hair that sticks out in different directions. He also had large light-coloured eyes. He wore a dark turtleneck, pants, a pair of sandals, and a flak jacket not unlike Konohagakure's, with multiple chest pockets.

He was a fairly experienced shinobi, exceling in Water Release techniques. With it, he can create a stream of water that bursts out of the ground in his chosen-direction, slicing anything it comes into contact with, even rock. He also utilised a long-distance technique, being able to fire off powerful water projectiles capable of knocking out large men with a single blow.
